items.title: Arthur Vigne Interview, 1961-11-29
items.q: Because my daddy died when I was only thirteen year old.

ctx.x: I was trying to figure if your father were living, he'd be about a hundred years old I guess. In his nineties then. Yeah. He died forty, I don't know, forty five years ago. He doesn't look close to a hundred then, wasn't he?

Yeah he would, he would. Because he died when he was around, up in his fifties. And he was dead a good forty five years ago. Because my daddy died when I was only thirteen year old. And I know that's a good forty five years ago. Because I'm fifty eight now.
Do you remember any of the cabarets that you went to to see your father play? Do you remember any that he played at?
